decisions.reason: The flame-retardant jacquard serves the contract and hospitality segment, had its own website page and embodies certification and development investment, so management will attribute any slow uptake to long project cycles and persist with it.

The double-face wool-blend fabric fits the announced shift toward renewable fibers, which gives management a reason to justify keeping it, although its low visibility and the firm's quick withdrawal of A and B raise the risk of rotation.

The wool bouclé leno required development effort and supports the sustainability direction, so management will likely keep it for another season despite only modest web presence and the firm's habit of rotating collections.
Launched only in 2024 with its own website page, the braided fabric is a fresh and visible commitment, and management will not abandon it before it has had a full market cycle.
